brand.name: Holdfast
brand.tagline: Hold fast to what you back.
brand.sector: Launchpad cripto: financiación de proyectos con USDC

sentence.en: Back the projects you believe in. Your money stays locked until the team delivers.

set.name: Fine Print
set.mechanism: La letra chica del contrato hecha con cuidado: una serif editorial para la voz, una grotesca sobria para los números y dos barras paralelas, como una prensa que sujeta, en tinta y verdín sobre papel.
set.expression_move: La serif Newsreader en tamaño grande es lo único expresivo; el símbolo son solo dos barras que sujetan.
set.differs_by: Ningún competidor usa serif: el sector va de sans técnicas y colores eléctricos; Fine Print se ve como una publicación financiera seria, no como una app.

logo.concept: La palabra Holdfast en serif editorial; las dos barras son la prensa que mantiene el dinero en su lugar.
logo.defect: El signo igual era más pesado que la serif y le robaba la voz; barras más finas y cortas.

rationale.claim: Instrument Serif se descartó porque no tiene cifras tabulares; Newsreader sí y tiene eje óptico para títulos grandes.
El verdín se eligió para no usar el azul ni el morado habituales en cripto.

findings.message: light: success #087b4e and accent #2c7a67 are only CIEDE2000 8.2 apart; users may read one as the other

suggested_fix.how: darken by OKLCH L -0.05, same hue

findings.message: dark: success and danger collapse to CIEDE2000 7.2 for deutanopia (#b5ad8d vs #bfb175)

suggested_fix.how: never carry meaning by colour alone (icon/label); or darken by OKLCH L -0.09, same hue

findings.message: light: border #e6e6e6 on background #ffffff is 1.25:1, below 3.0:1 (borders: dividers are exempt, input outlines need 3:1; WCAG 2, no rounding)
dark: border #414141 on background #0f0f0f is 1.88:1, below 3.0:1 (borders: dividers are exempt, input outlines need 3:1; WCAG 2, no rounding)
Newsreader lacks English auxiliary/punctuation characters: ʻ
findings.suggested_fix: fine if the brand never writes them (loanwords, names); else another family

findings.message: Newsreader: ~105 KB WOFF2 for the brief's characters (one variable file, all weights; estimate)
Hanken Grotesk lacks English auxiliary/punctuation characters: ʻ
findings.suggested_fix: fine if the brand never writes them (loanwords, names); else another family

findings.message: Hanken Grotesk: ~29 KB WOFF2 for the brief's characters (one variable file, all weights; estimate)
sets too alike on the axes: A–C differ by 2+ steps on fewer than 2 axes (heuristic)
no es translation of the tool text; 38 label(s) shown in English
findings.suggested_fix: translate assets/i18n/en.json (keep keys and {placeholders}) to es and save it as <work>/i18n.json with "_lang": "es", then re-run
